title: The bubble
body: Set a scanned cube down anywhere and right-click it: a glowing bubble grows out of it with the scan inside, shrunk to ten blocks across. From outside you see it in blue; step in and it has its real colours, under the scanned sky.

It is only a picture over the real world, which is never touched. Where the real world is empty you can stand on the scan's ground; you walk straight through the rest. Use a scanned chest to look inside it.
Right-click again to switch it off.
